lines.en: Croaked whisper, moves slowly.
Copies footsteps, approaches silently.
Swallows sound, moves slowly.
Crawls slowly, mimics steps.
Imitates a light cough, sneaks closer.
Imitates breath, moves silently.
Copies footsteps, advances slowly.
Mimics player steps, sneaks in.
Imitates breath, silent.
Imitates walking sounds, moves closer.

lines.zh: 每一步都学你，踩在雾里。
lines.en: Every step copied from yours, through the fog.

lines.zh: 拖着仿制的靴子，踏雾而来。
lines.en: Dragging copied boots through the mist.

lines.zh: 我把剑柄的角度调到一模一样。
lines.en: I set the angle of my sword hilt to match exactly.

lines.zh: 雾里的呼吸声，全是学你的。
lines.en: Every breath in the mist is copied from yours.
Camouflages, hiding unnoticeably.
Gazes at player, ready to act.
Silently hiding, unseen.
Quietly observing, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 我在断柱后练你的站姿。
lines.en: Behind the broken pillar, I practice your stance.
Quietly probing, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我照着你的装备，长了一身。
lines.en: I grew a body copied from your gear.

lines.zh: 我照着你的样子，慢慢拼。
lines.en: I'm piecing myself together in your shape.

lines.zh: 藏在一模一样的盔甲里，不动。
lines.en: Hiding inside an identical suit of armor.
Wearing your expression, waiting for you to turn.
The thicker the fog, the more I look like you.

lines.zh: 站在断柱后面，学你的站姿。
lines.en: Behind a broken pillar, copying your stance.
Fixes on player, ready to mimic.
Gleams, sneaks a look at the player.

lines.zh: 我照着你的样子，抄好了装备。
lines.en: I copied your look, gear and all.
I copy you, down to the gear.
Stares at player, ready to mimic.
Gazes at player, ready to capture.

lines.zh: 我数清你护甲上的每道划痕。
lines.en: I count every scratch on your armor.
Stares at player, ready to attack.
Glares at player, ready to capture.

lines.zh: 先看清你的脸，再学会它。
lines.en: First I study your face, then I learn it.

lines.zh: 你护甲上的纹路，我已记下。
lines.en: I have memorized the pattern on your armor.

lines.zh: 这道目光，是从你眼里借的。
lines.en: This stare is borrowed from your eyes.
You frown, so I frown too.

lines.zh: 雾里多了一双你的眼睛。
lines.en: The fog now holds a pair of your eyes.
I mimic your hand as it moves.

lines.zh: 我数着你身上每一块铁。
lines.en: I count every plate of iron on you.
You turn your head, I turn mine.

lines.zh: 这具身体，正在慢慢变成你。
lines.en: This body is slowly becoming yours.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，照亮了我的轮廓。
lines.en: Your torch lights up my outline.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会看到自己。
lines.en: Do not look back, or you will see yourself.

lines.zh: 你感受到我的模仿了吗？
lines.en: Feel my mimicry.

lines.zh: 模仿你的装备，模仿你的恐惧。
lines.en: Copying your gear, copying your fear.

lines.zh: 你的武器，现在是我的武器。
lines.en: Your weapon, now mine.

lines.zh: 模仿你，是我唯一的生存之道。
lines.en: Copying you is my only way to survive.

lines.zh: 你给的伤害，我也会还你。
lines.en: Damage you do, I’ll do back.

lines.zh: 只有更好的装备，才能让我生存。
lines.en: Better gear means survival.

lines.zh: 模仿你的脚步，模仿你的呼吸。
lines.en: Copying your steps, your breath.

lines.zh: 你装备的精华，也是我的。
lines.en: Your gear’s essence is mine.

lines.zh: 每一份装备，都是我的一份力量。
lines.en: Each piece of gear is a power boost.

lines.zh: 你的装备，就是我的武器库。
lines.en: Your gear is my arsenal.

lines.zh: 你身上的盔甲如此耀眼，我为何不能拥有？
lines.en: Why should I not have your armor?

lines.zh: 你的武器散发光芒，我要学习你的力量。
lines.en: Your weapon shines; I want to learn your strength.

lines.zh: 你佩戴的饰品，我也有欲望。
lines.en: Your adornments are mine as well.

lines.zh: 观察你，模仿你，我逐渐强大。
lines.en: By watching you, I grow stronger.

lines.zh: 你的食物也是我的，尝一尝吧。
lines.en: Your food is mine as well, try it.

lines.zh: 在这迷雾中，你是我的猎物。
lines.en: In this fog, you are my prey.
Your shadow is mine.

lines.zh: 模仿你，直到你认不出我。
lines.en: Copy you until you cannot recognize me.

lines.zh: 迷雾中的猎物，我已等待多时。
lines.en: Prey in the fog, I've waited long.

lines.zh: 你的恐惧，就是我的食粮。
lines.en: Your fear, my food.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的时候，会发现自己无处藏身。
lines.en: When you touch me, you'll have nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我在这迷雾中，随时准备迎接你。
lines.en: I'm always ready for you in this fog.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞，只会让我更近。
lines.en: Your collision brings me closer.

lines.zh: 即使相撞，你也看不见我。
lines.en: Even in collision, you can't see me.

lines.zh: 我的存在，只在你触摸到我时。
lines.en: My existence is only when you touch me.

lines.zh: 你永远不知道，何时会与我相撞。
lines.en: You never know when you'll collide with me.

lines.zh: 碰撞，让我更贴近你的世界。
lines.en: Collision brings me closer to yours.

lines.zh: 你与我相撞，便注定要消失。
lines.en: You collide with me, and you'll vanish.

lines.zh: 每一次相撞，都是我的胜利。
lines.en: Every collision is my victory.

lines.zh: 你触碰我的那一刻，便输了。
lines.en: You lose the moment you touch me.

lines.zh: 同类的存在，是完美的模仿。
lines.en: A perfect mimic among equals.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，如同镜中的你。
lines.en: My mate, like you in the mirror.

lines.zh: 找到你，是我的终极目标。
lines.en: Finding you is my ultimate goal.
Your existence completes me.

lines.zh: 我追求的，是与你的融合。
lines.en: I seek fusion with you.

lines.zh: 你是我的唯一，我的伴侣。
lines.en: You are my only, my mate.

lines.zh: 同类之中，我找到了归属。
lines.en: Among equals, I found belonging.

lines.zh: 与你结合，是我永恒的追求。
lines.en: Joining with you is my eternal pursuit.

lines.zh: 我的灵魂，渴望你的存在。
lines.en: My soul craves your presence.
Your presence strengthens me.
Sssss, mine now.
Copy you, easy as that.
Nice gear you have there.
Remember, this is my copy.
Hey, copy me!
Your gear, mine now.

lines.zh: 模仿你，是我的生存之道！
lines.en: Copy you, my survival way.
Look at my copy.
My gear matches yours.
Copy, my instinct.

lines.zh: 我学你走路，学得挺像吧。
lines.en: I walk like you; convincing, no?
Your scent, I follow.
Prey, so delicious.

lines.zh: 我克隆的靴子踩上了你的脚印。
lines.en: My copied boots step into your footprints.
Track you, my nature.

lines.zh: 我穿上你的装备，像不像你？
lines.en: Wearing your gear — do I look like you?
Your shadow, mine now.
I come, fear me.
Prey, my target.
Track, my instinct.
That shape in the fog is mine now.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，把位置卖了。
lines.en: Your footsteps gave away your place.
A living scent cuts through the mist.
I choose you as my next face.
You walked too deep and met me.
The ruin's fog brought you to me.
Your soul, mine.
Target, eat.
Feel the fear.
Target you, my choice.
My prey, my food.
Taste my venom.

lines.zh: 我学你的步子，等你回头。
lines.en: I copy your steps and wait for you to look back.
Target you, my duty.
My prey, my weapon.
Target you, my instinct.
Stand still and let me finish learning you.

lines.zh: 别动，我还没记住你的肩宽。
lines.en: Hold still, I have not memorized your shoulders.
The fog will close off your way back.

lines.zh: 你的破绽，我全看在眼里。
lines.en: I have noted every gap in your guard.
I advance in your rhythm.
You step back, I step forward.

lines.zh: 一样的装备，不一样的下场。
lines.en: Same gear, different ending.
I have borrowed your shadow.
The mist closes in, leaving just us.

lines.zh: 我数三下，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: I count to three, then you cannot run.

lines.zh: 模仿你的步伐，吞噬你的力量！
lines.en: Copy your stride, steal your strength!
All your gear is mine now.
Your armor, mine to wear.
I must copy you to defeat you.
In the fog, just you and me.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的食物，成为更强！
lines.en: Your food, my power.
Fog creatures, eternal copies.
Your blood, my sustenance.

lines.zh: 模仿你的声音，让你颤抖！
lines.en: Copy your voice, make you quake.
Copy you until you fall.
I copy your swordplay swing for swing.

lines.zh: 这柄复制来的剑，试试看。
lines.en: Try this copied blade.
Your own move, back into your ribs.
Same face, crueler hand.

lines.zh: 雾中一击，你分不清真假。
lines.en: One strike in the fog, and you cannot tell which is real.
I raise my arm like yours, then bring it down.
In the fog, I wait for you.
Night falls, you will be copied.
I will copy you, be you.
Wandering in fog, seeking prey.
Fog ruins, my home.

lines.zh: 浓雾漫过断墙，我照着你的轮廓起来。
lines.en: Fog spills over the broken wall and I rise in your outline.
Your shadow, my target.
Copy you, forever.
In the fog, you have nowhere to run.
I will follow you forever.

lines.zh: 迷雾遗迹，又多了一个我。
lines.en: One more of me in the foggy ruins.

lines.zh: 断墙后面，我照着你的样子长。
lines.en: Behind the broken wall, I grow in your shape.
When the fog rose, I borrowed someone's skin.

lines.zh: 在埋骨的废墟里，我睁眼。
lines.en: In the bone-buried ruin, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 你脚下的影子，刚刚站起。
lines.en: The shadow at your feet just stood up.

lines.zh: 石柱的影子里，走出一个你。
lines.en: From a pillar's shadow walks out a you.
Before the fog lifts, I am already here.

lines.zh: 遗迹的霉味里，混进我的呼吸。
lines.en: My breath joins the moldy smell of the ruin.
I crawl out of the pile of fog-bound bones.

lines.zh: 又一副面孔，在雾里成形。
lines.en: Another face takes shape in the mist.

lines.zh: 火把我刚学会的脸烧熔了。
lines.en: Fire melts the face I just learned.
Falling breaks my disguise.

lines.zh: 水淹没了我真实的形态。
lines.en: Water reveals my true form.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我抄来的盔甲撕成两半。
lines.en: The blast tears the armor I copied in two.
The arrow pierces me.
The magic cuts through me!
Starvation betrays me.
The lightning pierces my disguise.
The void reveals my true form.
